notes: The Sunnyside Neighborhood Association's newsletter (NEWSunnyside, Sunnyside Neighborhood Association News, Sunnyside News), Spring 1975 to Fall 1994: the 29 issues in the Internet Archive collection sanfrancisconewspapers. None has hOCR; text and leaves are rebuilt from each item's _djvu.xml (/mnt/project-files/mission-papers/dl_djvu.py), and citations give the issue and the leaf. Read by hand, with no reader pass: the numbered-address passages, the advertisement-filtered passages (extra_windows.py) and a pass over event words (kw_scan.py). extra.candidate is the row key in /mnt/project-files/mission-papers/decisions_small2.py. Kept: Thomas Malim's history of the Sunnyside Conservatory and the house beside it, serialised from Winter 1976 to Spring 1977; openings and moves; construction dates. Not kept: officers' and members' home addresses, advertisements, the Association's positions on City College parking and zoning, reminiscences of private families, and the planning decisions at 236, 370 and 380 Monterey that the commission minutes and the Glen Park papers had already put on the pages. People named: William Augustus Merralls (died 1914) and Ernest Van Beck (died 1952), past owners the series documents, and a builder. The later owners of the conservatory are not named. extra.placement_note says where a number came from when the passage prints none.

coverage.remaining: Nothing remains in the Sunnyside newsletter.
coverage.note: 29 issues; 298 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets, 256 of them advertisements on Monterey Boulevard. 25 passages kept by the filter, 39 more looked at with the advertisement filter off, and 95 event-word passages, all read by hand. 20 findings written, each quote found again in the issue's text. 15 resolved and published on 8 pages (1 seeded: 311 Joost, where the newsletter's date for the front house is set against the assessor's roll). 4 held, each one thin fact on a parcel with no page (298 Monterey, 663 Mangels, 771 Monterey, 499 Monterey). 1 unresolved: the nursery school at 435 Monterey, whose building the roll dates to 1987.
